title: Recordkeeping and retention periods
definition: The requirement to create and retain the records that support a report, and to keep them for the period the rule specifies, generally five years from the date of the report. The records that must be kept are those a reasonable person would expect to be needed to demonstrate that the report was made and that the institution complied with the underlying obligations. This record summarises the requirement.
evidence_to_cite: the retained record, and the date it was created
the retention period applied, and the date the record will be destroyed
the report the record supports, where there is one

sources.citation: Recordkeeping and retention requirements (31 CFR 1010.430), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
